results.title: Datadog Launches AI-Powered Root Cause Analysis for Cloud Infrastructure
results.description: Datadog today announced Bits AI Root Cause Analysis, an AI-powered feature that automatically identifies the root cause of infrastructure incidents, reducing mean time to resolution by up to 60%.

results.title: Datadog Reports Q1 2026 Revenue of $780M, Up 28% Year-over-Year
results.description: Datadog reported first quarter 2026 revenue of $780 million, an increase of 28% year-over-year, with operating income of $142 million. The company raised full-year guidance.

results.title: Datadog Hiring 500+ Engineers Globally as Observability Demand Surges
results.description: Cloud monitoring leader Datadog is expanding its engineering team with 500+ new hires across offices in New York, Paris, and new sites in Austin and Seoul, citing growing enterprise demand for unified observability.
